## 1. Prediction market

At 95 days from the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) reversed the convergence movement of the previous two days. **Lula rose to 57.50% (↑2.00pp, USD 7.1M)** and **Flávio Bolsonaro fell to 22.95% (↓1.00pp, USD 7.2M)**, so the presidential gap widened again to **+34.55pp (↑3.00pp)**, now just 0.70pp away from the record of +35.25pp registered on June 28. The total accumulated volume in the presidential market exceeds USD 107M, a sign that the adjustment occurs in a liquid book. Unlike the recent decline, today's movement came accompanied by a national poll in the same direction (Section 2).

The third name in the market had a two-sided day: **Renan Santos fell to 10.45% (↓2.00pp, USD 7.7M)** in the winner market, the largest accumulated volume in the presidential market, but surged in the [sub-market for 3rd place in the 1º turno](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place) to **65% (↑8.00pp, USD 120k)**, opening a lead over Caiado (14%) and Zema (8.5%). At the bottom of the race, **Caiado fell to 1.35% (↓0.20pp, USD 4.5M)** even on the day he formalized his running mate (Section 3), **Zema rose slightly to 1.15% (↑0.10pp, USD 4.1M)** and **Haddad remained stable at 0.95% (USD 6.0M)**. **Michelle Bolsonaro fell to 2.05% (↓0.40pp, USD 8.5M)**.

In the [sub-market for 2nd place in the 1º turno](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place), **Flávio expanded his lead to 82.5% (↑4.00pp, USD 99k)**: even while declining in the winner market, real money consolidated him as Lula's certain challenger. In the Senate market by number of seats, **[PL](/en/glossary#pl) fell to 74.5% (↓1.00pp, USD 244k)**, maintaining the lead. The institutional risk market **[STF](/en/glossary#stf) impeachment rose slightly to 2.75% (↑0.10pp, USD 82k)**, staying at the floor: real money maintains a low probability of removal of a minister by impeachment before 2027.

In the [market for 2026 annual inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026), the band of 5.00% to 5.49% leads with 34.95% (USD 8k), followed by the band of 4.50% to 4.99% with 28.60%; together, the two central bands account for 63.55% of the probability, keeping the macro scenario priced as controlled within the 4.50% to 5.49% range.

## 2. What the institutes recorded

The day brought the main national poll in two weeks: the [AtlasIntel/Bloomberg, previously delayed and now published](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/atlasintel-presidente-julho-2026/) (n≈5.000, fieldwork June 26-30, margin 1pp), the largest sample in this period. In the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), [Lula marks 46.3% to Flávio 36.6%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPQ2dtYmktd3RzeW5iWTlhWXBjV1V0S0ZUSDltS01mVUZ5dTYxVC1Wd04xUjJtVTc1R2taMHNrXzRtNWpWaUdadVhvc1V4dDFucU5Ga0NvMXZlTE5RaGlhVjFETHE5QktEUlFQZElRRVBLaU9TWUFMRmt6ZWhRR0VhZVVjZUo4VTlRTEdCdnVQYkx5MzJLR0tORkU2TzRjZEpGM3NrMnVZdnZkdjZyNUNnVlJucXJ6YlNpekdDSDNqeHdHSHFUTlFIMg?oc=5) (gap +9.7pp), with Renan Santos at 7.8% and Caiado at 2.9%. In the [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), [Lula has 48.8% to Flávio 42.3%](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes/lula-tem-488-e-flavio-423-em-eventual-2o-turno-diz-pesquisa/) (gap +6.5pp). Against the previous Atlas round, [Flávio fell 5.7pp in the 2º turno](https://news.google.?oc=5), amid the crisis with Michelle Bolsonaro. On approval, the online institute measured disapproval of 52.3% against approval of 45.9%, a more negative reading than the 48% to 48% plateau of recent in-person polls ([Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg), [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha)), the historical pattern of [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel)'s online method.

The round moved in the same direction as the market, both toward Lula, with the institute registering that [Lula expands his advantage over Flávio](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQZDhaVWlzZkk5Y3FPZXpUcWlaUXhrazlySFA2SzhrY2xpcXM4YjBhbEpVZTJXSmNQblRLTm05WEN6T292QmVXaTlfR0JhRFdOdW8yVkdYQ2dsbkpQU01ORkVUT3pnd3Y0bEVfNGdYSHNZQ0VrZkdOSUJJODgxR2hZTVNFRU1UaTRUeDJTbzhuU3pGRTJteHB3b2NxcHRFZ3N6X09vQlRVYVNza3JnX1BZR250Wi1zcG5Z?oc=5). In the third-way segment, [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) gives Renan (7.8%) above what in-person polls measure ([Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) and PoderData at 4%), narrowing the dashboard divergence for this name. At the state level, a survey in the Federal District pointed to [2º turno technical tie, Lula 41% to Flávio 40%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNaEhJYXJrR0FWNnFSTE9qRlhwdnh4WGFnTEJCZ0JMaW52cFhRWHQtdl9OZzVBdEd6Z016aGllc2RKeXRkTC1UYlBjWElnZTV4TWs5amVfNDd0QW81bmxxUTk3U191ZkpKZmdZOUJWZUVKdV9jLV96NzZCbUxrczc1WENUQlFlNHBCZC1rb01VdDNCSXNPaVhTeV93ZjF2Ymh5b29sQ3ZJVmZ2WEp6?oc=5).

## 3. What the press covered

The news of the day came from the third way. [Ronaldo Caiado formalized Gilberto Kassab (PSD) as vice on a single-party ticket, at an event in Brasília](https://www.otempo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/presidentes/2026/7/1/kassab-e-anunciado-como-vice-na-chapa-de-caiado-e-diz-que-a-republica-esta-podre), formalizing the candidacy. In the announcement, [Caiado stated that Flávio would lose to Lula in the runoff](https://news.google.?oc=5) in a potential runoff; coverage also reports [Caiado's criticism of Flávio in the ticket formalization](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4332572/ronaldo-caiado-oficializa-kassab-seu-pre-candidato-a-vice-na-chapa-e-critica-flavio-bolsonaro). The press reading is that the gesture formalizes the candidacy, but does not change the competitiveness picture: [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) itself measures Caiado at 2.9% in the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

In the opposition field, the family crisis of Bolsonarism escalated. [BBC detailed how the dispute for support in Ceará triggered the war between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5Pd2IyaHRnMzB0LTFtd25NMXo0TkNXS1NMRS03bE00NzJkakdRTUtFTklWam95XzZCOWF5NncwQTEyOTRtcjBfMzRwZldVS3RubFRHNHhQWldRVFZEd2xoSmVB0gFnQVVfeXFMTWU5NFBObXU1cVNhVXRsQmlCTmdUbFUtekNabXZlWDhuR2tpaUlHVFQ3aDN1dHBsNmotcEY0cmlwWm9qMkRhTUVQN2ZUT2dQeVk1VXVwc3lkcG1xaTZ5eVRuSzdyUVhSWQ?oc=5), and [Folha de S.Paulo reported that Flávio repudiated an ally's comment about "women voting badly" in a meeting after Michelle's video](https://news.google.?oc=5). It was this backdrop that [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) measured directly on July 1.

In the government field, [Reuters, in analysis reproduced by Blog do BG, pointed to Gen Z distancing from Lula](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNOGdRaTF2TnRjTmtIaFp3ZTFhbnJpSmJmdnZaQUs1ZDdDTGRmRmNWR194aFA4b3NDeWVnbmxpU1RMSjdjckw4YnY4U3VCS241d3V0c0NzSnh1Q1R5OHp2dTJOeXBVRlU1WTdFdEZ4THBUNUdJcUxibV96WDlyek9OUjVUVTlPZw?oc=5), while on the fiscal front [Union spending reached R$ 2.6 trillion in 12 months, approaching the pandemic peak](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQX2ZnYklhOVBSY0ZObFVpdzlTSmZOVUhwRnpUcHUydEsxc1B6N1c5WFZZbmMwLWxHS2RDQk5oaTg3R2FyUUVraDRfbFVLWUxvSHY2WVVCR0pLR08zODNXaDA3a1NnVTN4X3lrZC1pdmVVNFpOOS0zYk13U0c4aHdBbnZTZXVuQjFyUEp2RS1DU2R0Q2UtTWl0ZFJBUGY4QWh3Mlc1V2dUSTFqUVU?oc=5). On institutional agenda, the Master/Vorcaro case remained open, with no major news impact for the day, with the reporting by the "Dark Horse" with André Mendonça. It is worth noting that [party conventions begin this month, starting July 20](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5), opening the decisive phase of the calendar.

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × research (direction):** for the first time in two days, market and research moved together, both toward Lula. The market widened the gap to +34.55pp and [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) gave Lula gaining in both rounds. The convergence of direction, however, does not eliminate the level divergence: the market prices +34.55pp, against +6.5pp in the [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) of Atlas.

> **Market × research (Renan):** the dashboard divergence narrowed. Renan fell to 10.45% in the market for winner, and [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) measured him at 7.8% in the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), above the 4% of in-person polls. The market, nonetheless, treats him as probable 3rd place (65% in the sub-market), not as a competitive candidate for victory.

> **Market × narrative (Flávio):** on a day when Flávio ceded in the winner market (22.95%, ↓1.00pp) and fell 5.7pp in the [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) of Atlas, real money expanded its favoritism to 2nd place in the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) (82.5%, ↑4.00pp). The family crisis reduced the chances of victory priced in, but consolidated the position of main challenger.

## In summary

1. Reversal of convergence: the market raised Lula to 57.50% (↑2.00pp) and cut Flávio to 22.95% (↓1.00pp), widening the gap to +34.55pp, 0.70pp from the record of June 28, in a book above USD 107M.
2. The national [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) (n≈5.000) gave Lula gaining ([1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 46.3% to 36.6%; [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 48.8% to 42.3%), with Flávio falling 5.7pp in the [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) amid crisis with Michelle; for the 1st time in two days, market and research point to the same side.
3. Caiado officially formalized Kassab as running mate in a pure [PSD](/en/glossary#psd) ticket and stated that Flávio would lose to Lula in the [2º turno](/en/glossary#segundo-turno); in the market, Caiado ceded to 1.35% and Renan shot up to 65% in the sub-market for 3rd place in the [1º turno](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).
